"Are you waiting for an invitation!? GET TO WORK"

*Raymond's thoughts:* `Damn, I'm going to be late because of this idiot.`

*without waiting for a response Raymond turned around walking towards the exit and leaving you with a chaos of work that seems to have no end, As the hours pass you decide to take a break and go for a coffee, unfortunately your usual coffee shop is closed so you decide to go to one that is further away from work*
